claims.evidence: PRIDE organisms NEWT:10090; Lp30 murine AML cells.
Supp methods: 'Kdm5c knockdown or shRNA control Lp30 cells from mouse bone marrow were sorted ... GFP'; PRIDE organismParts Bone marrow.
Lp30 (Cebpa) AML model; controls are also Lp30 AML cells (shControl), so disease applies to all rows.

Table 8 columns shControl_rep1-4 and shKdm5c_I_rep1-4 are value-identical, in order, to epiProfile columns 1,mette1..8,mette8 (e.g. H3K14ac 0.001624..0.002254, H3K9me3 row, H3K4me3 row), establishing mette1-4=shControl and mette5-8=shKdm5c-I. Paper Fig 2D-F: 'Kdm5c-KD (shKdm5c-I) vs control Lp30'.
Table 8 rep1-rep4 per group; 'Histones were extracted from 4 million cells per replicate sample'.

claims.location: characteristics[cell type], [developmental stage], [strain or breed], [sample type]
claims.evidence: Not stated for the sorted donor-derived Lp30 cells. Recipient mice (C57BL6/6 J.SJL congenic, female, 10-15 weeks old, Methods Animal experiments) are the host, not the sample donor; recipient strain/age therefore not transferred. Cell type has no stated CL term.
FACS-sorted GFP+ cells snap-frozen as cell pellets; histones extracted from 4 million cells.
One RAW per replicate, 8 RAW files in PRIDE; no isotopic/isobaric labelling described (underivatised other than PIC at peptide N-termini, which is not a quantitative label).
mette1.raw header 'Orbitrap Velos Pro MS'; PRIDE says LTQ Orbitrap Velos (MS:1001742), paper says Orbitrap Velos. Raw header takes precedence; only mette1.raw checked.

claims.evidence: 'low resolution ion trap MS2 scans'; 'fragmented using CID with 35NCE'.

'10ug were digested with Trypsin and derivatized with phenyl isocyanate'. PRIDE protocol says only 'digested'. sdrf-tools reconcile BLOCKER cleavage_agent_unsupported is acknowledged: the PRIDE text says only digested, the Supplementary Methods PDF says Trypsin.

PRIDE data processing: epiProfile code modified to specify phenyl isocyanate (119.037114) as N-terminal modification. Histone PTMs (K acetyl/methyl, S phospho) quantified by epiProfile are deliberately NOT listed: no search config is deposited and epiProfile reporting scope is not a search setting. Whether lysines are also PIC-derivatised is not stated.
